# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When volatility contracts (ATR at a low percentile) and then expands with a volume surge, the ensuing breakout tends to continue, offering a tradable momentum edge. The compression phase indicates low expected movement, and the volume‑spike breakout signals genuine participation rather than a false move.

## Mechanism

Calculate 20‑bar ATR. If current ATR is below the 20‑bar 20th percentile (compression) and the next bar closes above the high of the compression zone (or below the low for short) with volume > 1.5× the 20‑bar average volume, enter in the direction of the breakout. Exit: stop at the opposite edge of the compression zone (chart‑stop), TP1 at 2R, runner trailed using a trailing stop set at 15% off the highest high (or lowest low) after TP1. Regime hint: effective in low‑to‑moderate VIX (<20) and during mid‑day (11:00‑14:00) when liquidity is steady; avoid during the first 15 minutes after major economic releases.
